_comment: Chrome Enterprise policy to force-install the extension on managed devices.
Or configure via Group Policy (Windows) / MDM profile (macOS).
Option A: Self-hosted CRX with auto-update XML
Replace YOUR_EXTENSION_ID with the actual extension ID after packing.
Host the .crx and updates.xml on your internal server.
Option B: Chrome Web Store (recommended for auto-updates)
Upload to Chrome Web Store (can be unlisted), then use the CWS extension ID.
Format: EXTENSION_ID (no update URL needed for CWS).
